Backend Engineer (Entry Level)

Join our platform team as an entry-level backend engineer. You will build API endpoints, write tests, and learn our services and database stack.

Requirements:
- Familiarity with Python and REST APIs
- Some exposure to SQL databases and Docker
- Willingness to learn distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
notes: Backend discipline at entry-level seniority; thin but relevant resume against a junior JD. Exercises the entry-level case and a mid-low expected band.
